title: Carrier escalation and late-delivery recovery
text: For an in-transit order at high risk of missing its promised SLA date (<24h SLA remaining or transit bottleneck), operations may prepare a priority carrier escalation draft. The escalation must not be submitted until an authorised operations reviewer approves it. A goodwill voucher draft may be proposed up to BRL 25.00. Automatic refunds and money movement are strictly prohibited in the autonomous agent workflow. Customer messages must remain drafts and must not be sent automatically. Cite this policy version in the audit record.

title: Proactive customer communications and goodwill credit
text: RetailFlow may draft an empathetic delivery update when evidence indicates likely delay exceeding 24 hours. The draft may include a revised delivery estimate supported by carrier tracking evidence. A customer retention credit of up to BRL 20.00 is permitted subject to supervisor sign-off. External delivery, email, SMS, WhatsApp, direct CRM contact, and financial promises require explicit human approval and a separate connector. The autonomous agent is advisory and cannot send messages directly.

title: Chronic Late Seller Dispatch Intervention and Remediation
text: If a seller exhibits dispatch elapsed time exceeding 48 hours or historical late dispatch rate >= 15% with recent exceptions >= 3, operations is permitted to prepare a priority merchant warning, request express pickup dispatch, or reallocate inventory. Goodwill compensation up to BRL 35.00 may be proposed for affected buyers. Permanent merchant bans without audit are prohibited.

title: Enterprise Responsible AI and Guardrail Governance
text: All autonomous agent recommendations must pass deterministic enterprise safety checks before being presented to operators. Strict boundaries enforce: (1) Prompt injection defense (hidden or override instructions are rejected), (2) Supported draft action types only, (3) Mandatory Human-in-the-Loop approval for external actions, (4) Strict monetary caps in Brazilian Reais (BRL), and (5) Audit logging of all tool invocations and model inference reasoning.
